sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Thursday, July 22, 1999, 50 FBI agents arrived in Forresta on the western edge of Yosemite National Park.
sentences.zh: 1999年7月22日星期四，50名联邦调查局特工抵达了位于优胜美地国家公园西缘的福雷斯塔。

sentences.en: The wintry conditions that had clouded the region months earlier had since dissipated, replaced by warmer weather and greener scenery.
sentences.zh: 几个月前笼罩该地区的寒冷天气早已消散，取而代之的是温暖的气候和翠绿的景色。

sentences.en: The area where the female human remains were found was relatively unknown to tourists.
sentences.zh: 发现这具女性遗体的区域对游客来说相对陌生。

sentences.en: Its dense woodland and grassy meadows were split by a rushing stream.
sentences.zh: 茂密的林地和草地被一条湍急的溪流一分为二。

sentences.en: The granite summits of Yosemite Valley were visible in the distance.
sentences.zh: 远处可以看到优胜美地山谷的花岗岩峰顶。

sentences.en: Trampled vegetation revealed what had likely taken place there.
sentences.zh: 被踩踏的植被揭示了那里可能发生过的事情。

sentences.en: It appeared the woman had been chased into the woods by an assailant before they got into a struggle.
sentences.zh: 看起来这名女子在被袭击者追赶进树林后，双方发生了搏斗。

sentences.en: She put up a fight, wounding her wrist in the process.
sentences.zh: 她进行了反抗，过程中手腕受了伤。

sentences.en: But her attacker overpowered her.
sentences.zh: 但袭击者最终制服了她。

sentences.en: The victim was then cleanly and forcefully decapitated with a large, sharp instrument.
sentences.zh: 随后，受害者被一件大型锐器干净利落地斩首。

sentences.en: Although the victim's head was nowhere to be found, investigators were still able to identify her.
sentences.zh: 尽管受害者的头部不见踪影，调查人员仍设法确认了她的身份。

sentences.en: Less than 100 yards away was the cabin where missing 26-year-old naturalist Joey Armstrong lived.
sentences.zh: 不到100码外就是26岁失踪自然学家乔伊·阿姆斯特朗居住的小木屋。

sentences.en: In the 1990s, the Cedar Lodge in El Portal was owned and operated by a man named Gerald Fisher.
sentences.zh: 20世纪90年代，位于埃尔波塔尔的雪松旅馆由一名叫杰拉尔德·费舍尔的男子拥有并经营。

sentences.en: Located on Highway 140, the lodge was a popular rest stop for visitors to Yosemite National Park.
sentences.zh: 该旅馆位于140号公路上，是优胜美地国家公园游客的热门休息站。

sentences.en: Its grounds stretched across 27 acres at the base of a tree-covered hillside, with the Merced River flowing nearby.
sentences.zh: 旅馆占地27英亩，坐落在一座树木繁茂的山脚下，默塞德河从附近流过。

sentences.en: All up, there were 211 rooms in the hotel, which were divided between several buildings.
sentences.zh: 酒店共有211间客房，分布在几栋建筑内。

sentences.en: The lodge had all the amenities one would expect, including a restaurant and a swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 旅馆拥有人们所期望的所有设施，包括餐厅和游泳池。

sentences.en: In the summer of 1997, Gerald hired a young man to carry out general maintenance duties and upkeep at the Cedar Lodge.
sentences.zh: 1997年夏天，杰拉尔德雇佣了一名年轻人负责雪松旅馆的日常维护和保养工作。

sentences.en: Like other employees, the newcomer lived on site in a studio apartment above the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 和其他员工一样，这名新人住在餐厅楼上的单间公寓里。

sentences.en: Friendly, dependable, and seemingly normal, he established a good rapport with his boss and co-workers.
sentences.zh: 他友好、可靠，看起来很正常，与老板和同事相处得很好。

sentences.en: He was an unremarkable, average Joe type of guy who mostly kept to himself.
sentences.zh: 他是一个平平无奇、普通得像邻家男孩一样的人，平时大多独来独往。

sentences.en: Yet, he did have one noteworthy feature.
sentences.zh: 然而，他确实有一个值得注意的特征。

sentences.en: His surname.
sentences.zh: 他的姓氏。

sentences.en: In February 1999, Carol Sand, her teenage daughter Julie, and Sylvina Peloso, an exchange student staying with the pair, were murdered in proximity of Yosemite.
sentences.zh: 1999年2月，卡罗尔·桑德、她十几岁的女儿朱莉，以及与她们住在一起的交换生西尔维娜·佩洛索在优胜美地附近遇害。

sentences.en: The trio had been visiting the region for a brief holiday, but disappeared from the Cedar Lodge after a two-night stay.
sentences.zh: 这三人当时在该地区进行短暂度假，但在入住雪松旅馆两晚后失踪。

sentences.en: The hotel's employees were questioned, and although several raised suspicions, the facility's maintenance man did not.
sentences.zh: 酒店员工接受了询问，虽然几个人引起了怀疑，但酒店的维修工却没有。

sentences.en: His reputation as an unassuming boy next door, coupled with an unblemished police record, kept him off investigators' radars.
sentences.zh: 他那谦逊的邻家男孩形象，加上清白的犯罪记录，使他避开了调查人员的视线。

sentences.en: He remained calm and collected when answering questions, and was ruled out after providing an alibi.
sentences.zh: 他在回答问题时保持冷静沉着，并在提供不在场证明后被排除了嫌疑。

sentences.en: Carol and Sylvina's bodies were discovered in the charred remains of their rental car a few hours' drive northweSt.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔和西尔维娜的遗体在西北方向几小时车程外的一辆烧焦的租赁汽车中被发现。

sentences.en: The killer then taunted police by sending them a map that led to Julie's son's body, 30 miles from where her mother was found.
sentences.zh: 凶手随后通过寄给警方一张地图来嘲弄他们，地图指向了朱莉儿子的遗体，距离她母亲被发现的地方有30英里远。

sentences.en: The triple homicide came to be known as the Yosemite Sightseer Murders.
sentences.zh: 这起三尸命案后来被称为“优胜美地游客谋杀案”。

sentences.en: Investigators returned to the Cedar Lodge on the lookout for the source of dark pink fibres found on Julie's body.
sentences.zh: 调查人员回到雪松旅馆，寻找在朱莉身上发现的深粉色纤维的来源。

sentences.en: The hotel's maintenance man escorted detectives across the grounds, using his set of master keys to let them in to each room.
sentences.zh: 酒店的维修工陪同侦探在场地内巡视，并用他的一套万能钥匙带他们进入每个房间。

sentences.en: He happily chatted about his life and family, specifically his younger brother, Stephen.
sentences.zh: 他愉快地聊起自己的生活和家庭，特别是他的弟弟斯蒂芬。

sentences.en: It was a peculiar and intriguing topic, but the interaction didn't raise any red flags.
sentences.zh: 这是一个独特而有趣的话题，但这次互动并没有引起任何警觉。

sentences.en: The man's willingness to help was appreciated, and the detectives left.
sentences.zh: 这名男子的配合态度受到了赞赏，侦探们随后离开了。

sentences.en: The sunned Peloso case inevitably hit a roadblock.
sentences.zh: 佩洛索案的调查不可避免地陷入了僵局。

sentences.en: The trio's killer remained a mystery, though investigators were certain that a group of local men, all of whom had a history of violence, were responsible.
sentences.zh: 这三人的凶手仍然是个谜，尽管调查人员确信是一群有暴力前科的当地男子所为。

sentences.en: By the time they were spotlighted as suspects, the men were in police custody for a litany of reasons, none of which related to Carol, Julie, or Sylvina's murders.
sentences.zh: 当他们被列为嫌疑人时，这些人已经因各种原因被警方拘留，其中没有一项与卡罗尔、朱莉或西尔维娜的谋杀案有关。

sentences.en: Five months later, Joey Armstrong was killed in Forasta.
sentences.zh: 五个月后，乔伊·阿姆斯特朗在福雷斯塔遇害。

sentences.en: The crime scene was about a 30-minute drive from the Cedar Lodge, along a route that branched off to where Carol, Julie, and Sylvina were found.
sentences.zh: 犯罪现场距离雪松旅馆约30分钟车程，沿途的分支路线通往发现卡罗尔、朱莉和西尔维娜的地方。

sentences.en: The FBI were quick to establish there was no connection between the crimes.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局很快确定这些罪行之间没有联系。

sentences.en: They told the public there was no reason to believe there was a continuing threat in the area, or that a killer or killers planned to act again.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉公众，没有理由相信该地区存在持续的威胁，也没有理由相信凶手计划再次作案。

sentences.en: The evening before Joey Armstrong's remains were found in the forest behind her home, a US Park Service firefighter was visiting the area.
sentences.zh: 在乔伊·阿姆斯特朗的遗体于她家后的森林中被发现的前一天晚上，一名美国公园管理局的消防员正在该地区巡视。

sentences.en: As he drove along Forasta Road, he noticed a familiar car parked on the edge of the woods.
sentences.zh: 当他沿着福雷斯塔路行驶时，注意到一辆熟悉的汽车停在树林边缘。

sentences.en: It was a blue and white 1972 International Scout SUV, an off-road vehicle akin to a Jeep.
sentences.zh: 那是一辆蓝白相间的1972年国际侦察兵SUV，一种类似于吉普车的越野车。

sentences.en: It just so happened that the firefighter knew who owned the distinctive car.
sentences.zh: 碰巧的是，这位消防员知道这辆独特的汽车是谁的。

sentences.en: After learning about this sighting, FBI agents returned to the Cedar Lodge.
sentences.zh: 在得知这一目击情况后，联邦调查局特工回到了雪松旅馆。

sentences.en: They ascended the stairs leading to the floor above the restaurant and arrived at the apartment belonging to the hotel's maintenance worker.
sentences.zh: 他们登上通往餐厅楼上的楼梯，来到了酒店维修工的公寓。

sentences.en: Knocks to the front door went unanswered.
sentences.zh: 敲门声无人应答。

sentences.en: The man wasn't home.
sentences.zh: 那个人不在家。

sentences.en: A search of the grounds also failed to locate him.
sentences.zh: 对场地的搜查也没能找到他。

sentences.en: The agents continued looking.
sentences.zh: 特工们继续寻找。

sentences.en: They crossed the highway at the lodge's entrance and headed towards the Merced River on the other side.
sentences.zh: 他们穿过旅馆入口处的公路，向另一侧的默塞德河走去。

sentences.en: Something moving about in the river caught their attention.
sentences.zh: 河里有什么东西在动，引起了他们的注意。

sentences.en: It was a man swimming naked.
sentences.zh: 那是一个正在裸泳的男人。

sentences.en: The act was a public offence, so the agents summoned him out of the water.
sentences.zh: 这种行为属于公然猥亵，所以特工们把他叫出了水面。

sentences.en: He turned out to be the very person they were looking for.
sentences.zh: 他正是他们要找的人。

sentences.en: Carey Stainer had been working as the Cedar Lodge's maintenance man for the past two years.
sentences.zh: 凯里·斯泰纳在过去两年里一直担任雪松旅馆的维修工。

sentences.en: As a formality, he'd been questioned about the Yosemite sightseer murders.
sentences.zh: 作为例行公事，他曾就优胜美地游客谋杀案接受过询问。

sentences.en: Stainer wasn't technically a lodge employee at the time of the triple homicide.
sentences.zh: 在三尸命案发生时，斯泰纳在技术上并不是旅馆的员工。

sentences.en: His job was seasonal and he'd been laid off a month earlier due to lack of work.
sentences.zh: 他的工作是季节性的，由于工作量不足，他在一个月前被解雇了。

sentences.en: He remained living at the hotel and found himself with an abundance of free time.
sentences.zh: 他继续住在酒店里，发现自己有大量的空闲时间。

sentences.en: This gave the avid outdoorsman plenty of opportunities to explore the woods around his home.
sentences.zh: 这让这位狂热的户外运动爱好者有了充足的机会去探索家周围的树林。

sentences.en: By late March, the spring tourist season was kicking off.
sentences.zh: 到了3月下旬，春季旅游旺季开始了。

sentences.en: Stainer was rehired one month after the murders.
sentences.zh: 斯泰纳在谋杀案发生一个月后被重新聘用。

sentences.en: He was never suspected for the crime.
sentences.zh: 他从未被怀疑犯下那起罪行。

sentences.en: And even when his blue and white International Scout SUV was sighted near Joey Armstrong's cabin on the afternoon she was killed, it still didn't raise concerns.
sentences.zh: 即使当他的蓝白相间国际侦察兵SUV在乔伊·阿姆斯特朗遇害当天下午出现在她的小木屋附近时，也没有引起担忧。

sentences.en: It was thought he might have seen something significant while in the area.
sentences.zh: 人们认为他可能在那个地区看到了什么重要的事情。

sentences.en: That's all.
sentences.zh: 仅此而已。

sentences.en: Carey Stainer emerged naked from the Merced River.
sentences.zh: 凯里·斯泰纳赤身裸体地从默塞德河中走出来。

sentences.en: He dressed and gathered up his backpack, then accompanied the waiting FBI agents to his apartment.
sentences.zh: 他穿好衣服，收拾好背包，然后陪同等候的联邦调查局特工前往他的公寓。

sentences.en: Stainer remained calm when questioned in relation to Joey Armstrong's murder.
sentences.zh: 斯泰纳在接受关于乔伊·阿姆斯特朗谋杀案的询问时保持冷静。

sentences.en: He denied involvement and allowed his SUV to be searched.
sentences.zh: 他否认参与其中，并允许搜查他的SUV。

sentences.en: Nothing of importance was found.
sentences.zh: 没有发现任何重要的东西。

sentences.en: Yet, Stainer was far more evasive when it came to his backpack.
sentences.zh: 然而，当涉及到他的背包时，斯泰纳显得更加闪烁其词。

sentences.en: When detectives requested to inspect it, he refused.
sentences.zh: 当侦探要求检查背包时，他拒绝了。

sentences.en: They seized the item and obtained a search warrant.
sentences.zh: 他们扣押了该物品并获得了搜查令。

sentences.en: Inside the bag, they found a camera, a beer bottle, sunflower seeds, tanning lotion, a harmonica, and a fictional crime novel titled Black Lightning.
sentences.zh: 在包里，他们发现了一台相机、一个啤酒瓶、葵花籽、美黑乳液、一把口琴和一本名为《黑色闪电》的虚构犯罪小说。

sentences.en: The book featured graphic descriptions of women being slaughtered with knives and power saws.
sentences.zh: 书中详细描述了女性被刀和电锯屠杀的血腥场面。

sentences.en: Stainer's backpack also contained duct tape, a .22 calibre revolver, and a knife.
sentences.zh: 斯泰纳的背包里还有胶带、一把.22口径左轮手枪和一把刀。

sentences.en: Although troubling, these items were legal.
sentences.zh: 虽然令人不安，但这些物品是合法的。

sentences.en: They were also everyday tools for a handyman who lived in the woods.
sentences.zh: 对于一个住在树林里的杂工来说，这些也是日常工具。

sentences.en: As they didn't directly implicate Stainer in Joey's murder, he was let go.
sentences.zh: 由于它们没有直接将斯泰纳与乔伊的谋杀案联系起来，他被释放了。

sentences.en: The following day of Friday, July 23, Carey Stainer didn't show up for work.
sentences.zh: 第二天，即7月23日星期五，凯里·斯泰纳没有来上班。

sentences.en: He'd never taken a day off before, so his colleagues checked his apartment.
sentences.zh: 他以前从未请过假，所以同事们去检查了他的公寓。

sentences.en: He wasn't home.
sentences.zh: 他不在家。

sentences.en: When the county sheriff was informed that Stainer was missing, there was little doubt that he had fled after coming under scrutiny for Joey Armstrong's murder.
sentences.zh: 当县治安官被告知斯泰纳失踪时，毫无疑问，他在因乔伊·阿姆斯特朗的谋杀案受到审查后逃跑了。

sentences.en: As he was known to be armed, tracking him down became a top priority.
sentences.zh: 由于已知他持有武器，追踪他成了当务之急。

sentences.en: Police across the state were ordered to be on the lookout for the 37-year-old, who was tall and lean with tanned skin and cropped, greying dark hair.
sentences.zh: 全州警察接到命令，搜寻这名37岁的男子，他身材高大瘦削，皮肤黝黑，留着修剪整齐的灰白深色头发。

sentences.en: Local media were informed, and soon the Stainer name was making news across the state once again.
sentences.zh: 当地媒体得到了通知，很快斯泰纳的名字再次成为全州新闻的焦点。

sentences.en: Joey Armstrong's cabin and the encompassing woodland was still crawling with FBI agents and local law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 乔伊·阿姆斯特朗的小木屋和周围的林地里仍然挤满了联邦调查局特工和当地执法人员。

sentences.en: That evening, a park ranger stood by the stream near where Joey's body had been found.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，一名公园护林员站在发现乔伊遗体附近的溪流旁。

sentences.en: They headed downstream, and after 40 or so feet, spotted something floating in the shallows.
sentences.zh: 他们顺流而下，在大约40英尺后，发现浅滩里有什么东西在漂浮。

sentences.en: It was Joey's head.
sentences.zh: 那是乔伊的头颅。

sentences.en: 150 miles away in Sacramento County, Janet DeMant was preparing for a typical weekend night of drinking and darts.
sentences.zh: 150英里外的萨克拉门托县，珍妮特·德曼特正在准备一个典型的周末夜晚，打算喝酒和玩飞镖。

sentences.en: Janet was a resident of Laguna de Sol, a clothing optional resort on the outskirts of Sacramento City.
sentences.zh: 珍妮特是萨克拉门托市郊区一个名为“太阳泻湖”的服装可选度假村的居民。

sentences.en: Shortly after 11pm, Janet ventured to the resort lounge where she noticed a familiar face sitting at the bar.
sentences.zh: 晚上11点刚过，珍妮特来到度假村休息室，注意到吧台坐着一张熟悉的面孔。

sentences.en: The man had visited the resort a few times before, and as recently as March that year.
sentences.zh: 这个男人以前来过度假村几次，最近一次是在那年的3月。

sentences.en: Janet remembered that visit well.
sentences.zh: 珍妮特对那次访问记忆犹新。

sentences.en: He had worn a t-shirt featuring the word Yosemite and a cap embroidered with the Cedar Lodge logo.
sentences.zh: 他当时穿着一件印有“优胜美地”字样的T恤，戴着一顶绣有雪松旅馆标志的帽子。

sentences.en: His outfit prompted Janet to ask him about the Yosemite sightseer murders.
sentences.zh: 他的装束促使珍妮特问起他关于优胜美地游客谋杀案的事。

sentences.en: It was the talk of the town, as the three victims had only just been discovered.
sentences.zh: 那是当时的热门话题，因为三名受害者才刚刚被发现。

sentences.en: The man explained that he had gotten out of Yosemite because there were cops everywhere.
sentences.zh: 那个男人解释说，他离开了优胜美地，因为到处都是警察。

sentences.en: When Janet spotted the same man at the Laguna de Sol lounge nearly four months later, she approached him again.
sentences.zh: 近四个月后，当珍妮特在太阳泻湖休息室再次看到同一个男人时，她又走近了他。

sentences.en: He was focused on a television screen above that displayed the news, so their conversation was brief.
sentences.zh: 他正专注于上方播放新闻的电视屏幕，所以他们的谈话很简短。

sentences.en: She asked how he was doing.
sentences.zh: 她问他最近怎么样。

sentences.en: He said that he had packed up his truck and was planning to head interstate, to somewhere like Oregon or Utah.
sentences.zh: 他说他已经收拾好卡车，计划去州外，去俄勒冈州或犹他州之类的地方。

sentences.en: The next day, Janet woke early and happened to catch the morning television news.
sentences.zh: 第二天，珍妮特醒得很早，碰巧看到了早间电视新闻。

sentences.en: An FBI agent appeared on screen, urging viewers to contact the Bureau if they came across Carrie Stainer, wanted for questioning in relation to the murder of Joey Armstrong.
sentences.zh: 屏幕上出现了一名联邦调查局特工，敦促观众如果遇到凯里·斯泰纳，请联系调查局，他因与乔伊·阿姆斯特朗的谋杀案有关而被通缉。

sentences.en: Janet recognised the fugitive as the man she had spoken to at Laguna de Sol on several occasions, including the night before at the bar.
sentences.zh: 珍妮特认出这名逃犯就是她曾在太阳泻湖多次交谈过的那个男人，包括前一天晚上在酒吧里。

sentences.en: She rushed to the telephone.
sentences.zh: 她冲向电话。

sentences.en: After calling the FBI, Janet alerted the manager of Laguna de Sol that a wanted man was residing on site.
sentences.zh: 在给联邦调查局打电话后，珍妮特通知了太阳泻湖的经理，一名被通缉的男子正住在那里。

sentences.en: Grounds keepers were immediately dispatched to the area where Carrie Stainer had pitched his tent the day before.
sentences.zh: 场地管理员立即被派往凯里·斯泰纳前一天搭帐篷的地方。

sentences.en: They began pruning nearby shrubs to subtly keep an eye on him until police arrived.
sentences.zh: 他们开始修剪附近的灌木，以便在警察到达之前悄悄监视他。

sentences.en: Eventually, Stainer emerged.
sentences.zh: 最终，斯泰纳出现了。

sentences.en: He was scheduled to check out the next morning of Sunday July 25.
sentences.zh: 他原定于第二天，即7月25日星期日退房。

sentences.en: Yet, he started packing up and preparing his vehicle as though he were planning to leave that very moment.
sentences.zh: 然而，他开始收拾行李并准备车辆，好像打算立刻离开。

sentences.en: Resort staff feared he knew something was awry and was making a hasty escape.
sentences.zh: 度假村工作人员担心他察觉到了什么异常，正准备仓促逃跑。

sentences.en: Stainer checked the daily paper and conveniently, his getaway hadn't yet made headlines.
sentences.zh: 斯泰纳查看了日报，巧合的是，他的逃亡还没有成为头条新闻。

sentences.en: This seemingly gave him a false sense of security.
sentences.zh: 这似乎给了他一种虚假的安全感。

sentences.en: Instead of fleeing the resort, he put on a cap and went to grab a bite to eat.
sentences.zh: 他没有逃离度假村，而是戴上帽子去吃点东西。

sentences.en: At 9am, half a dozen FBI agents and local police officers arrived at Laguna de Sol.
sentences.zh: 上午9点，六名联邦调查局特工和当地警察抵达了太阳泻湖。

sentences.en: They were directed to the on-site restaurant where several guests were eating breakfast, many of them naked.
sentences.zh: 他们被指引到现场的餐厅，那里有几位客人在吃早餐，其中许多人赤身裸体。

sentences.en: Sitting alone at a corner booth with his back to the door was a man who immediately drew their attention.
sentences.zh: 一个背对着门独自坐在角落卡座里的男人立刻引起了他们的注意。

sentences.en: Unlike the people around him, he was wearing clothes, jeans, a t-shirt with Yosemite on the front and a camouflage-patterned hat.
sentences.zh: 与周围的人不同，他穿着衣服：牛仔裤、一件正面印有“优胜美地”的T恤和一顶迷彩图案的帽子。

sentences.en: It was Carey Stainer.
sentences.zh: 正是凯里·斯泰纳。

sentences.en: As soon as Stainer noticed the men moving towards him, he stood and raised his hands.
sentences.zh: 斯泰纳一注意到向他走来的人，就站起来举起了双手。

sentences.en: He remained calm as he was handcuffed and informed that he was under arreSt.
sentences.zh: 他在被戴上手铐并被告知已被逮捕时保持冷静。

sentences.en: It was a two-hour drive to the FBI field office in Sacramento.
sentences.zh: 前往萨克拉门托联邦调查局外勤办公室需要两个小时的车程。

sentences.en: Throughout the journey, Stainer engaged his escorts in light-hearted chit-chat, unfazed by his predicament.
sentences.zh: 在整个旅程中，斯泰纳与押送人员进行了轻松的闲聊，对自己的困境毫不在意。

sentences.en: At one point, the conversation steered towards another member of the Stainer family.
sentences.zh: 有一次，谈话转向了斯泰纳家族的另一名成员。

sentences.en: Carey was the oldest of five children.
sentences.zh: 凯里是五个孩子中的老大。

sentences.en: He had three sisters and a brother, Stephen.
sentences.zh: 他有三个妹妹和一个弟弟，斯蒂芬。

sentences.en: The Stainer siblings were close, but Carey was particularly protective of Stephen, who was four years his junior.
sentences.zh: 斯泰纳兄妹关系亲密，但凯里特别保护比他小四岁的斯蒂芬。

sentences.en: The pair had a strong bond.
sentences.zh: 两人有着深厚的感情。

sentences.en: They spent their early years playing together in the wilderness around their home and enjoyed frequent family trips to Yosemite National Park.
sentences.zh: 他们早年常在家附近的荒野中一起玩耍，并经常享受全家去优胜美地国家公园的旅行。

sentences.en: When Carey was 11, his brother vanished without a trace.
sentences.zh: 凯里11岁时，他的弟弟消失得无影无踪。

sentences.en: Stephen Stainer's story is covered in episode 154 of Case File.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·斯泰纳的故事在《Case File》第154集中有讲述。

sentences.en: During Stephen's absence, Carey would often retreat outdoors for respite from his grieving family.
sentences.zh: 在斯蒂芬失踪期间，凯里经常躲到户外，从悲伤的家庭中寻求喘息。

sentences.en: At night, he'd look up at the stars and wish for Stephen's safe return.
sentences.zh: 晚上，他会抬头仰望星空，祈祷斯蒂芬能平安归来。

sentences.en: Years passed and Carey found joy in art.
sentences.zh: 岁月流逝，凯里在艺术中找到了乐趣。

sentences.en: He was voted most creative in his graduating class, and many believed he would go on to have a career in graphic design.
sentences.zh: 他被评为毕业班中最有创造力的人，许多人认为他将来会从事平面设计工作。

sentences.en: Yet, Carey's youth was overshadowed by Stephen's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 然而，凯里的童年却笼罩在斯蒂芬失踪的阴影之下。

sentences.en: He felt abandoned and neglected.
sentences.zh: 他感到被抛弃和忽视。

sentences.en: Seven years after his little brother vanished, Carey's wish came true.
sentences.zh: 在弟弟失踪七年后，凯里的愿望成真了。

sentences.en: Stephen returned home alive at age 14.
sentences.zh: 14岁的斯蒂芬活着回到了家。

sentences.en: He had been abducted by a pedophile and held in captivity for seven years.
sentences.zh: 他曾被一名恋童癖者绑架并囚禁了七年。

sentences.en: Carey and Stephen shared a room together from then on, but their relationship was fraught and they argued constantly.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，凯里和斯蒂芬住在一个房间里，但他们的关系十分紧张，经常发生争吵。

sentences.en: Carey blew off steam by taking solo trips to Yosemite, where he ran through the woods, swam naked, and smoked cannabis.
sentences.zh: 凯里通过独自前往优胜美地旅行来发泄情绪，在那里他在树林里奔跑、裸泳并吸食大麻。

sentences.en: As Carey recited these experiences to his arresting officers in 1999, he became emotional.
sentences.zh: 1999年，当凯里向逮捕他的警官讲述这些经历时，他情绪激动。

sentences.en: Mainly over the inadequate sentencing his brother's kidnapper had received.
sentences.zh: 主要是因为他弟弟的绑架者所受的刑罚太轻了。

sentences.en: By the time Stainer was placed in an interview room at the FBI's field office, he was once again upbeat.
sentences.zh: 当斯坦纳被带进联邦调查局外勤办公室的审讯室时，他又变得兴高采烈起来。

sentences.en: But his cooperation thereafter came at a disturbing coSt.
sentences.zh: 但他随后的配合却付出了令人不安的代价。

sentences.en: I'd like to see pictures, he requested.
sentences.zh: “我想看照片，”他要求道。

sentences.en: Of little girls.
sentences.zh: “小女孩的照片。”

sentences.en: Although he was unwilling to say it explicitly, Stainer was asking to view child exploitation material in exchange for a statement.
sentences.zh: 尽管他不愿明说，但斯坦纳是在要求以观看儿童剥削影像作为提供供词的交换条件。

sentences.en: The urge to see such imagery, Stainer said, had been gnawing away at him his entire life.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳说，观看此类影像的冲动折磨了他一生。

sentences.en: The FBI had no intention of giving Stainer what he wanted.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局无意满足斯坦纳的要求。

sentences.en: Instead, they pretended to procure the illicit content to bide time and keep him rambling on.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们假装去获取这些非法内容，以争取时间并让他继续喋喋不休。

sentences.en: In the meantime, detectives offered him pizza in an effort to get him to open up about the reason he was arrested.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，侦探们给了他披萨，试图让他说出被捕的原因。

sentences.en: The murder of Joey Armstrong.
sentences.zh: 乔伊·阿姆斯特朗谋杀案。

sentences.en: Stainer took a bite and remarked,
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳咬了一口，评论道：

sentences.en: This will be my last meal as a free man.
sentences.zh: “这将是我作为自由人的最后一餐。”

sentences.en: He then looked at the detectives directly and said,
sentences.zh: 然后他直视着侦探们说：

sentences.en: I can give you closure.
sentences.zh: “我可以给你们一个了结。”

sentences.en: I can help answer questions about Joey.
sentences.zh: “我可以帮忙回答关于乔伊的问题。”

sentences.en: And more.
sentences.zh: “还有更多。”

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案件档案》继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: Nearly two decades earlier, in 1982,
sentences.zh: 近二十年前，即1982年，

sentences.en: Carey Stainer was driving along a back road that connected Cedar Lodge to Forresta.
sentences.zh: 凯里·斯坦纳正开车行驶在连接雪松旅馆和福雷斯塔的一条小路上。

sentences.en: Daylight was fading, so he flicked on his headlights.
sentences.zh: 天色渐暗，于是他打开了车前灯。

sentences.en: As they swept across the frame of an old, dilapidated barn,
sentences.zh: 当灯光扫过一座破旧的老谷仓时，

sentences.en: Stainer caught sight of something sheltering within.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳瞥见里面有什么东西在躲藏。

sentences.en: It was a large, hairy and muscular beaSt.
sentences.zh: 那是一只巨大、多毛且肌肉发达的野兽。

sentences.en: Stainer believed it was Bigfoot, an ape-like creature of North American folklore.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳认为那是大脚怪，一种北美民间传说中的类人猿生物。

sentences.en: The beast leapt up and ran into the surrounding woods while emitting a shriek that sounded like a woman screaming through a bullhorn.
sentences.zh: 野兽跳起来跑进了周围的树林，同时发出了一声尖叫，听起来就像一个女人对着扩音器尖叫。

sentences.en: The sighting sparked an obsession.
sentences.zh: 这次目击事件引发了他的执念。

sentences.en: Stainer often returned to Forresta in the hopes of seeing Bigfoot again.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳经常回到福雷斯塔，希望能再次见到大脚怪。

sentences.en: One such visit occurred on Wednesday, July 21, 1999.
sentences.zh: 其中一次造访发生在1999年7月21日，星期三。

sentences.en: Stainer parked his car on the edge of the woods and ventured inward.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳把车停在树林边缘，独自走了进去。

sentences.en: He came across a stream and began tossing rocks into it when he glimpsed a young woman through the trees.
sentences.zh: 他来到一条小溪边，开始往水里扔石头，这时他透过树丛瞥见了一名年轻女子。

sentences.en: She was moving back and forth between a cabin and her car, packing it with iteMs.
sentences.zh: 她在小屋和车子之间来回走动，正往车里装东西。

sentences.en: No one else appeared.
sentences.zh: 周围似乎没有其他人。

sentences.en: Stainer assumed she was alone.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳以为她是一个人。

sentences.en: As he spied on her, he felt a disturbing and familiar urge brewing inside him.
sentences.zh: 当他窥视她时，感到内心深处涌起一股令人不安且熟悉的冲动。

sentences.en: Cary Stainer first thought about killing women when he was just seven years old.
sentences.zh: 凯里·斯坦纳在七岁时就第一次产生了杀害女性的念头。

sentences.en: This predated his brother's abduction, so the thoughts were unrelated to Stephen's ordeal.
sentences.zh: 这发生在他弟弟被绑架之前，所以这些念头与斯蒂芬的遭遇无关。

sentences.en: He would stand in front of shop windows while fantasising about the female clerks inside dying.
sentences.zh: 他会站在商店橱窗前，幻想里面的女店员死去。

sentences.en: His visions became increasingly sadistic, and by age eight,
sentences.zh: 他的幻想变得越来越残忍，到了八岁时，

sentences.en: Stainer was imagining trapping a neighbourhood girl in a bunker and forcing her to undress.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳开始想象把邻居家的小女孩关进地堡，并强迫她脱掉衣服。

sentences.en: In his teens, he molested his sister's 14-year-old friend and confronted her while naked.
sentences.zh: 十几岁时，他猥亵了他妹妹14岁的朋友，并在赤身裸体的情况下与她对峙。

sentences.en: On another occasion, he exposed himself to her.
sentences.zh: 还有一次，他向她暴露了自己的下体。

sentences.en: His sister also witnessed this incident, but Stainer acted as though it were only a joke.
sentences.zh: 他妹妹也目睹了这一事件，但斯坦纳表现得好像这只是个玩笑。

sentences.en: After his parents' separation in the mid-1980s, Stainer moved to Merced to live with his uncle Jerry.
sentences.zh: 20世纪80年代中期父母分居后，斯坦纳搬到默塞德与他的叔叔杰瑞同住。

sentences.en: Years later, Jerry was killed after interrupting a home invasion.
sentences.zh: 多年后，杰瑞在阻止一起入室抢劫时被杀。

sentences.en: He had sustained a single gunshot to the chest administered by his own shotgun.
sentences.zh: 他胸部中了一枪，是死于自己的猎枪。

sentences.en: Cary Stainer was questioned in relation to the slaying, but was not considered a suspect after providing an alibi.
sentences.zh: 凯里·斯坦纳曾因这起谋杀案接受过问讯，但在提供不在场证明后，他被排除了嫌疑。

sentences.en: Stainer later alleged that he had been sexually abused by his uncle.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳后来声称自己曾遭到叔叔的性虐待。

sentences.en: Stainer left Merced soon after, and in 1997 took the maintenance job at the Cedar Lodge.
sentences.zh: 此后不久，斯坦纳离开了默塞德，并于1997年在雪松旅馆找到了一份维修工作。

sentences.en: Throughout this time, he expressed interest in women, but rarely pursued them and barely spoke about dating.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，他虽然表现出对女性的兴趣，但很少主动追求，也几乎不谈论约会的事。

sentences.en: In 1998, Stainer began casually dating a waitress who worked at the Cedar Lodge restaurant.
sentences.zh: 1998年，斯坦纳开始与雪松旅馆餐厅的一名女服务员随意交往。

sentences.en: She had two daughters, aged 10 and 7.
sentences.zh: 她有两个女儿，分别只有10岁和7岁。

sentences.en: Stainer supervised the girls while their mother worked, and they enjoyed hanging out with him.
sentences.zh: 在她们母亲工作时，斯坦纳负责照看这两个女孩，她们也很喜欢和他待在一起。

sentences.en: Over time, Stainer began fantasising about killing his girlfriend, then raping and murdering her daughters before setting their house on fire.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，斯坦纳开始幻想杀害女友，然后强奸并杀害她的女儿，最后放火烧掉她们的房子。

sentences.en: Whenever he went to carry out the attack, he would lose his nerve.
sentences.zh: 每当他准备实施袭击时，就会临阵退缩。

sentences.en: Then, one night, he finally decided to go through with it.
sentences.zh: 直到一天晚上，他终于下定决心要付诸行动。

sentences.en: On the night of Monday, February 15, 1999, Stainer went to his girlfriend's house with the intention of making his violent fantasy a reality.
sentences.zh: 1999年2月15日，星期一的晚上，斯坦纳带着将暴力幻想变为现实的意图去了女友家。

sentences.en: When a male visitor happened to stop by the house, Stainer was forced to abandon his plans.
sentences.zh: 当一名男性访客恰好来到家中时，斯坦纳被迫放弃了计划。

sentences.en: Surging on adrenaline, he returned to the Cedar Lodge and climbed into the hot tub to calm down.
sentences.zh: 肾上腺素飙升的他回到雪松旅馆，钻进热水浴缸试图让自己冷静下来。

sentences.en: He was soon joined by two teenage sisters who were staying at the hotel.
sentences.zh: 很快，两名住在旅馆的少女也加入了进来。

sentences.en: Neither girl was alarmed, nor felt there was anything off about the older man sharing the tub.
sentences.zh: 两个女孩都没有感到警惕，也不觉得和这个年长的男人共用浴缸有什么不妥。

sentences.en: They were completely oblivious to the fact that he was considering killing them.
sentences.zh: 她们完全不知道，他当时正动着杀她们的念头。

sentences.en: Stainer was quietly plotting his plan B murder scenario, in which he would rape and kill the two teens before him instead.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳正悄悄策划着他的“B计划”谋杀方案，打算强奸并杀害眼前这两名少女。

sentences.en: Once again, his plans fell through after he realised the pair were in the company of their father.
sentences.zh: 然而，当他意识到这对姐妹的父亲也在场时，他的计划再次落空了。

sentences.en: Frustrated, Stainer got out of the tub and spent the rest of the evening wandering aimlessly around the hotel grounds.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳感到沮丧，他走出浴缸，在酒店周围漫无目的地游荡了一整晚。

sentences.en: He eventually meandered towards the remote block of rooms on the edge of the woods.
sentences.zh: 最终，他溜达到树林边缘那片偏僻的客房区。

sentences.en: The area was near deserted, aside from a red Pontiac parked out the front of room 509, which was emitting a warm glow from within.
sentences.zh: 除了509号房门前停着一辆红色庞蒂亚克轿车，且屋内透出温暖的灯光外，周围几乎空无一人。

sentences.en: Stainer wandered past and glanced through the room's window.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳走过时，透过窗户往里瞥了一眼。

sentences.en: He noticed three female guests inside.
sentences.zh: 他注意到里面有三位女房客。

sentences.en: Carol, Julie and Sylvina were exhausted after a long day exploring Yosemite National Park.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔、朱莉和西尔维娜在优胜美地国家公园游玩了一整天，此时已精疲力竭。

sentences.en: The trio had retreated to their hotel room at the Cedar Lodge to settle in for their final night's stay.
sentences.zh: 三人回到雪松旅馆的房间，准备安顿下来度过最后一晚。

sentences.en: Carol rested on her bed with a book while Julie and Sylvina watched television together.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔躺在床上看书，朱莉和西尔维娜则在一起看电视。

sentences.en: The adjacent hotel rooms were empty.
sentences.zh: 隔壁的房间都空着。

sentences.en: They had the area all to themselves.
sentences.zh: 这片区域只有她们几个人。

sentences.en: At 11pm, the women were startled by a knock at the door.
sentences.zh: 晚上11点，一阵敲门声惊扰了这几位女性。

sentences.en: Carol moved to the window and saw a man standing outside dressed in camouflage pants and a black shirt.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔走到窗前，看到外面站着一个身穿迷彩裤、黑色上衣的男人。

sentences.en: He introduced himself as the hotel's maintenance man and spoke of a leak upstairs.
sentences.zh: 他自称是酒店的维修工，说楼上漏水了。

sentences.en: He wanted to see if it had impacted their room, but Carol refused to let him in.
sentences.zh: 他想看看是否影响到了她们的房间，但卡罗尔拒绝让他进入。

sentences.en: The man told her that he would retrieve the hotel manager.
sentences.zh: 那男人说他会去叫酒店经理来。

sentences.en: Carol let her guard down and opened the door.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔放松了警惕，打开了房门。

sentences.en: Carey Stainer entered room 509 carrying his backpack.
sentences.zh: 凯里·斯坦纳背着背包走进了509号房。

sentences.en: It contained its usual stockpile.
sentences.zh: 包里装着他惯用的作案工具。

sentences.en: Rope, duct tape, a knife, and his revolver.
sentences.zh: 绳子、胶带、一把刀，还有他的左轮手枪。

sentences.en: He moved into the bathroom and pretended to look for the non-existent leak.
sentences.zh: 他走进浴室，假装在寻找并不存在的漏水点。

sentences.en: After a little while, he re-entered the room, pulled out his gun, and told the women that nobody would get hurt if they kept quiet.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，他回到房间，掏出枪，告诉她们只要保持安静就不会受伤。

sentences.en: He took their money and car keys before ordering them to lie face down on the beds.
sentences.zh: 他抢走了她们的钱和车钥匙，随后命令她们脸朝下趴在床上。

sentences.en: Using the duct tape, he bound their hands behind their backs.
sentences.zh: 他用胶带将她们的双手反绑在身后。

sentences.en: Stainer shut Julie and Sylvina inside the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳把朱莉和西尔维娜关进了浴室。

sentences.en: He then returned to Carol, gagged her, and strangled her to death.
sentences.zh: 接着他回到卡罗尔身边，堵住她的嘴，将她勒死。

sentences.en: With Carol's limp body in his arms, Stainer emerged from the hotel room out into the parking area.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳抱着卡罗尔瘫软的尸体，走出酒店房间，来到停车场。

sentences.en: He moved towards the Pontiac, popped the trunk, and lowered Carol's body in.
sentences.zh: 他走向那辆庞蒂亚克，打开后备箱，把卡罗尔的尸体放了进去。

sentences.en: He then separated the teenagers.
sentences.zh: 随后，他将那两个少女分开了。

sentences.en: Julie was left in a neighbouring vacant room, while Stainer took Sylvina into 509's bathroom and strangled her in the bathtub.
sentences.zh: 朱莉被留在隔壁的空房里，而斯坦纳把西尔维娜带进509号房的浴室，在浴缸里将她勒死。

sentences.en: Her body was placed alongside Carol's.
sentences.zh: 她的尸体被放在了卡罗尔旁边。

sentences.en: Julie asked Stainer if he was going to kill her.
sentences.zh: 朱莉问斯坦纳是否会杀了她。

sentences.en: He answered no, before forcing her into the Pontiac's passenger seat.
sentences.zh: 他回答不会，然后强迫她坐进庞蒂亚克的副驾驶座。

sentences.en: She was concealed by a pink blanket taken from the hotel room.
sentences.zh: 她被从酒店房间拿来的一条粉色毯子遮盖住。

sentences.en: Prior to leaving Cedar Lodge, Stainer went about concealing his crimes.
sentences.zh: 在离开雪松旅馆前，斯坦纳着手掩盖自己的罪行。

sentences.en: He cleaned room 509 thoroughly and left some wet towels on the bathroom floor to imply that the guests had checked out after showering.
sentences.zh: 他彻底清理了509号房，并在浴室地板上留了几条湿毛巾，暗示房客洗完澡后已经退房离开了。

sentences.en: It was after 5 o'clock the following morning of Tuesday, February 16, when Stainer drove the Pontiac away from the lodge.
sentences.zh: 第二天，即2月16日星期二，清晨5点多，斯坦纳开车离开了旅馆。

sentences.en: The following 90 minutes were spent driving around aimlessly.
sentences.zh: 接下来的90分钟里，他一直在漫无目的地开车兜圈。

sentences.en: Eventually, he pulled into a paved viewpoint at the Don Pedro Reservoir.
sentences.zh: 最终，他把车开进了一个位于唐佩德罗水库的铺装观景点。

sentences.en: It was an area Stainer was familiar with, having camped and fished there with his family throughout his childhood.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳对这个地方很熟悉，他童年时常和家人来这里露营和钓鱼。

sentences.en: Stainer carried the still-bound Julie up a hiking trail and to a secluded spot out of view of the parking area.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳带着依然被绑着的朱莉走上一条徒步小径，来到一个停车场看不见的隐蔽地点。

sentences.en: Julie was lowered onto the pink blanket.
sentences.zh: 朱莉被放到了那条粉色毯子上。

sentences.en: Stainer told her that he loved her and that he wanted to keep her.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳告诉她，他爱她，想把她留在身边。

sentences.en: But he couldn't bear to look at her as he slit her throat, turning her face away so he didn't have to witness his own callous brutality.
sentences.zh: 但在割开她喉咙时，他却不忍直视，将她的脸转过去，这样他就不用目睹自己冷酷残暴的行径。

sentences.en: He hid Julie's body under a poison oak bush, gathered up the pink blanket, and headed back down the rise towards the Pontiac.
sentences.zh: 他把朱莉的尸体藏在毒橡树丛下，收起粉色毯子，沿着山坡走回庞蒂亚克车旁。

sentences.en: Before he left the reservoir, Stainer stopped to admire the sunrise.
sentences.zh: 在离开水库前，斯坦纳停下来欣赏了日出。

sentences.en: Stainer then drove to nearby Tuolumne County and pulled onto an old dirt logging road.
sentences.zh: 随后，斯坦纳开车前往附近的图奥勒米县，拐进了一条古老的土质伐木路。

sentences.en: He drove deep into the forest until the car jolted and stopped.
sentences.zh: 他深入森林，直到车子猛地颠簸了一下停住。

sentences.en: A tree stump had embedded into the Pontiac's undercarriage, preventing it from moving any further.
sentences.zh: 一个树桩卡进了庞蒂亚克的底盘，导致车子无法再移动。

sentences.en: By now, daylight was pouring through the trees.
sentences.zh: 此时，天光已透过树木洒了下来。

sentences.en: Fearing he might be seen, Stainer ditched the car and walked to a nearby payphone to order a taxi.
sentences.zh: 担心被人发现，斯坦纳弃车步行到附近的公用电话亭叫了一辆出租车。

sentences.en: Not long after, Jenny Paul pulled up in her cab.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，珍妮·保罗开着出租车赶到了。

sentences.en: Her passenger was a casually dressed, decent-looking man carrying a backpack.
sentences.zh: 她的乘客是一个穿着随意、看起来还算体面的男人，背着一个背包。

sentences.en: He looked tired, as though he hadn't slept at all the night before.
sentences.zh: 他看起来很疲惫，好像前一天晚上根本没睡。

sentences.en: His friends had ditched him, he explained, and he needed a ride back to a hotel near the Yosemite National Park.
sentences.zh: 他解释说朋友把他丢下了，他需要搭车回优胜美地国家公园附近的一家酒店。

sentences.en: Jenny obliged.
sentences.zh: 珍妮答应了。

sentences.en: The man quickly fell asleep, and only stirred when nearing his destination.
sentences.zh: 那男人很快就睡着了，直到快到目的地时才醒来。

sentences.en: He engaged Jenny in small talk, which primarily centred around the topic of Bigfoot.
sentences.zh: 他与珍妮闲聊，话题主要围绕着“大脚怪”。

sentences.en: Stainer paid the $125 taxi fare using cash from Carol's son's wallet, and made his own way back to the Cedar Lodge.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳用从卡罗尔儿子钱包里拿的现金支付了125美元的车费，然后自己回到了雪松旅馆。

sentences.en: The next day, he was back in Tewolomew County.
sentences.zh: 第二天，他又回到了图奥勒米县。

sentences.en: He drove down the old logging road and pulled his SUV to a stop near the Pontiac.
sentences.zh: 他沿着那条老伐木路开车，把自己的SUV停在庞蒂亚克附近。

sentences.en: At first, Stainer had opted to leave the car as is, thinking it wouldn't be linked back to him.
sentences.zh: 起初，斯坦纳选择维持原样，认为这辆车不会追查到他头上。

sentences.en: But doubts had since crept into his mind, and he decided to torture it, just to be safe.
sentences.zh: 但后来他心生疑虑，决定毁掉这辆车以求稳妥。

sentences.en: Stainer then carried out a series of crafty and sophisticated cover-up techniques that he had learnt from watching true crime shows.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳随后实施了一系列从真实犯罪节目中学来的狡猾且老练的掩盖手段。

sentences.en: He drove to the city of Modesto and tossed Carol's wallet onto a busy street to throw off search efforts once they inevitably commenced.
sentences.zh: 他开车前往莫德斯托市，将卡罗尔的钱包扔在一条繁忙的街道上，试图在搜查不可避免地展开时误导调查方向。

sentences.en: He re-entered room 509 and changed the bedding.
sentences.zh: 他回到509号房更换了床单。

sentences.en: Later, he penned the anonymous letter directing authorities to Julie's son's body, purposely writing,
sentences.zh: 后来，他写了一封匿名信，指引当局去寻找朱莉儿子的尸体，并特意写道：

sentences.en: We had fun with this one, to imply that multiple perpetrators were involved.
sentences.zh: “我们玩得很开心”，以此暗示有多个作案者参与。

sentences.en: Knowing the note would be analysed, he placed a page on top of it and scrawled random names that left behind imprints that would further confuse investigators.
sentences.zh: 他知道字条会被分析，于是放了一张纸在上面，胡乱写下一些名字，留下的压痕会进一步迷惑调查人员。

sentences.en: He also paid a kid he met at a fast food restaurant to lick the letters' envelope and stamp for him.
sentences.zh: 他还花钱请在快餐店遇到的一名小孩帮他舔信封和邮票。

sentences.en: Although he skipped town to Laguna de Sol when the bodies were found, he opted to return to Yosemite.
sentences.zh: 虽然在尸体被发现时他逃到了拉古纳德索尔，但他还是选择回到优胜美地。

sentences.en: A permanent departure in the height of a murder investigation would only raise suspicions.
sentences.zh: 在谋杀案调查最紧张的时候永久离开只会引起怀疑。

sentences.en: It was smarter for Stainer to stay put.
sentences.zh: 对斯坦纳来说，按兵不动更明智。

sentences.en: His efforts paid off.
sentences.zh: 他的努力奏效了。

sentences.en: Stainer was completely overlooked as a suspect in the Yosemite sightseer murders.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳作为优胜美地游客谋杀案的嫌疑人完全被忽略了。

sentences.en: Life for Cary Stainer carried on as per usual.
sentences.zh: 凯里·斯坦纳的生活照常继续。

sentences.en: Four months later, Stainer was standing in the Forrester Woods partaking in his ongoing search for Bigfoot.
sentences.zh: 四个月后，斯坦纳站在福雷斯塔树林里，继续着他寻找大脚怪的行动。

sentences.en: There was no sign of the beast, but something else had caught his eye.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有发现野兽的踪迹，但他却被别的东西吸引了注意力。

sentences.en: Overcome by a familiar impulse, he returned to his car and retrieved his backpack.
sentences.zh: 一种熟悉的冲动涌上心头，他回到车里拿出了背包。

sentences.en: Joey Armstrong was watering plants on her front porch when Stainer approached.
sentences.zh: 乔伊·阿姆斯特朗正在前廊浇花时，斯坦纳走了过来。

sentences.en: He complimented her on how nicely she had done up the cabin and asked if she'd ever seen Bigfoot.
sentences.zh: 他夸赞她把小屋布置得很好，并问她有没有见过大脚怪。

sentences.en: Joey hadn't, but said that one of her roommates might have.
sentences.zh: 乔伊说没见过，但提到她的一位室友可能见过。

sentences.en: Stainer asked if they were home.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳问她们在家吗。

sentences.en: Joey responded no, before turning to face the front door.
sentences.zh: 乔伊回答说不在，随后转身面向前门。

sentences.en: Behind her, Stainer pulled out his gun and held it to her head.
sentences.zh: 在她身后，斯坦纳掏出枪抵住了她的头。

sentences.en: He forced Joey into her bedroom and onto the bed.
sentences.zh: 他强迫乔伊进入卧室并按倒在床上。

sentences.en: She fought hard, but Stainer managed to restrain her hands behind her back and gag her.
sentences.zh: 她拼命反抗，但斯坦纳还是成功地将她的双手反绑并堵住了她的嘴。

sentences.en: He then dragged her outside and put her into the back of his SUV.
sentences.zh: 随后他将她拖到外面，塞进了SUV的后座。

sentences.en: As he drove off, Joey leapt out of the car window.
sentences.zh: 当他开车离开时，乔伊从车窗跳了出去。

sentences.en: She gained her footing and sprinted into the woods.
sentences.zh: 她站稳脚跟，向树林里飞奔而去。

sentences.en: Stainer pumped the brakes and scrambled out the car, before giving chase.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳猛踩刹车，从车里爬出来，紧追不舍。

sentences.en: It took him a while to catch up, but when he did, the pair fell to the ground in a heap near a stream.
sentences.zh: 他花了一会儿才追上，两人在小溪旁扭打成一团，摔倒在地。

sentences.en: Mid-fight, Stainer took the knife from his back pocket and slit Joey's throat.
sentences.zh: 打斗中，斯坦纳从后裤兜掏出刀，割开了乔伊的喉咙。

sentences.en: The forceful cut resulted in decapitation.
sentences.zh: 这一刀力道极大，导致了斩首。

sentences.en: Stainer considered keeping Joey's head as a trophy, but ultimately decided against it.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳曾考虑留下乔伊的头颅作为战利品，但最终打消了这个念头。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 案件档案稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案件档案》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Cary Stainer intended to kill many more women, including three Finnish tourists who stayed at the Cedar Lodge in 1998.
sentences.zh: 卡里·斯坦纳原本打算杀害更多的女性，包括1998年住在雪松旅馆的三名芬兰游客。

sentences.en: Armed with a metal pipe and duct tape, he tried accessing the trio's room using his master key.
sentences.zh: 他带着金属管和胶带，试图用万能钥匙进入这三人的房间。

sentences.en: He inadvertently woke the women up in the process, causing one to yell out in panic.
sentences.zh: 过程中他无意间吵醒了她们，导致其中一人惊恐地尖叫起来。

sentences.en: Stainer then fled the scene.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳随即逃离了现场。

sentences.en: No one had any idea he was behind the thwarted break-in.
sentences.zh: 当时没人想到这次未遂的入室行凶是他干的。

sentences.en: In fact, he was tasked with checking the locks to the room and reassuring the women they were safe.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他还被指派去检查房间门锁，并安抚她们说一切安全。

sentences.en: Weeks later, Stainer was compelled to kill several women he saw at the Merced River, but he lost his nerve when a man appeared.
sentences.zh: 几周后，斯坦纳本想杀害他在默塞德河看到的几名女性，但当一名男子出现时，他退缩了。

sentences.en: Then there were the young daughters of his current girlfriend and the teens from the Cedar Lodge hot tub.
sentences.zh: 此外还有他现任女友的年幼女儿，以及雪松旅馆热水浴缸里的那些青少年。

sentences.en: Stainer told detectives,
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳告诉侦探：

sentences.en: If you hadn't got me, there would have been more.
sentences.zh: “如果你们没抓住我，还会有更多受害者。”

sentences.en: Stainer's crimes came as a shock to those who knew him.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳的罪行让那些认识他的人感到震惊。

sentences.en: Though he was a quiet loner, he also came across as a regular guy who joked around with colleagues.
sentences.zh: 虽然他是个安静的独行侠，但他给人的印象也是个会和同事开玩笑的普通人。

sentences.en: Friends described him as trustworthy and gentle.
sentences.zh: 朋友们形容他值得信赖且温和。

sentences.en: He hadn't acted strangely when Carol, Julie and Sylvina disappeared, nor had he discussed the case with others.
sentences.zh: 在卡罗尔、朱莉和西尔维娜失踪时，他的行为并无异常，也没有和别人讨论过这个案子。

sentences.en: As such, many struggled to believe he was guilty, including his family.
sentences.zh: 因此，许多人包括他的家人在内，都难以相信他是有罪的。

sentences.en: After all the tragedy the Stainers had endured with Stephen, they couldn't comprehend how their eldest son could be a serial killer.
sentences.zh: 毕竟斯坦纳一家在斯蒂芬身上已经历了太多悲剧，他们无法理解自己的长子竟会是个连环杀手。

sentences.en: By now, evidence of Stainer's presence had been found throughout the Forresta crime scene.
sentences.zh: 此时，在福雷斯塔的犯罪现场各处都发现了斯坦纳存在的证据。

sentences.en: His fingerprints were in Joey Armstrong's bedroom, and his footprints and the tyre tracks from his SUV were pressed into the sand driveway alongside her cabin.
sentences.zh: 乔伊·阿姆斯特朗的卧室里有他的指纹，她小屋旁的沙地车道上留下了他的脚印和SUV的轮胎痕迹。

sentences.en: Stainer remained silent and stoic when indicted for Joey's murder.
sentences.zh: 当因乔伊的谋杀案被起诉时，斯坦纳保持沉默，神情冷漠。

sentences.en: Charges in relation to the Yosemite sightseer murders were also on the horizon.
sentences.zh: 与优胜美地观光客谋杀案相关的指控也即将到来。

sentences.en: Investigators were still searching for evidence that directly implicated Stainer in the triple homicide.
sentences.zh: 调查人员仍在寻找直接将斯坦纳与这起三尸命案联系起来的证据。

sentences.en: On July 24, Stainer agreed to take detectives on a guided tour of his crime scenes.
sentences.zh: 7月24日，斯坦纳同意带领侦探参观他的犯罪现场。

sentences.en: In the Forresta woods, he retrieved the knife he'd used to kill Joey Armstrong.
sentences.zh: 在福雷斯塔树林里，他找出了杀害乔伊·阿姆斯特朗的那把刀。

sentences.en: His bloody fingerprints were still on the handle.
sentences.zh: 刀柄上还留着他带血的指纹。

sentences.en: He also disclosed where the knife he used to kill Julie Sund could be found.
sentences.zh: 他还交代了杀害朱莉·桑德所用的刀藏在哪里。

sentences.en: The weapon was recovered, along with duct tape that matched the tape stuck to the 15-year-old's ankle.
sentences.zh: 凶器被找回，同时还有与粘在15岁女孩脚踝上的胶带相匹配的胶带。

sentences.en: Stainer pleaded not guilty when charged with the first-degree murders of Carol Sund, Julie Sund, and Silvina Peloso, as well as burglary, robbery, and kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 当被控一级谋杀卡罗尔·桑德、朱莉·桑德和西尔维娜·佩洛索，以及入室盗窃、抢劫和绑架罪时，斯坦纳拒不认罪。

sentences.en: Although he had withheld this from his initial confession, Stainer eventually admitted that his crimes were sexually motivated.
sentences.zh: 尽管他在最初的供述中隐瞒了这一点，但斯坦纳最终承认他的罪行是出于性动机。

sentences.en: He had murdered Silvina Peloso because she was too distraught to follow orders.
sentences.zh: 他杀害西尔维娜·佩洛索是因为她太慌乱，无法听从命令。

sentences.en: Julie Sund was kept alive as she was willing to do what she was told.
sentences.zh: 朱莉·桑德之所以能活下来，是因为她愿意听从他的摆布。

sentences.en: He had intended to kidnap and rape Joey Armstrong, but killed her when she resisted.
sentences.zh: 他原本打算绑架并强奸乔伊·阿姆斯特朗，但因她反抗而将其杀害。

sentences.en: As such, he also faced charges related to attempted sexual assault and rape.
sentences.zh: 因此，他还面临与性侵未遂和强奸相关的指控。

sentences.en: Stainer insisted that the murders were opportunistic and that he'd acted alone.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳坚称这些谋杀是临时起意，且是他独自所为。

sentences.en: The FBI faced backlash over this revelation.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局因这一披露而遭到强烈抨击。

sentences.en: They were accused of having tunnel vision for trying to link local criminals to the crimes, which allowed Carey Stainer to slip through the cracks.
sentences.zh: 他们被指责有“隧道视野”，试图将当地罪犯与这些案件联系起来，从而让卡里·斯坦纳成了漏网之鱼。

sentences.en: Although some evidence was tenuously linked to their initial suspects, the connections relied mostly on hearsay, unreliable confessions, and criminal histories.
sentences.zh: 尽管一些证据与他们最初的嫌疑人有微弱联系，但这些联系大多基于传闻、不可靠的供词和犯罪记录。

sentences.en: Investigators also focused too heavily on the calls from the person who tried to access Carol Sund's bank account, who to this day has never been identified.
sentences.zh: 调查人员还过于关注那个试图进入卡罗尔·桑德银行账户的人打来的电话，而此人至今未被查明身份。

sentences.en: Another blow came in the form of Jenny Paul, the taxi driver who had picked Stainer up the night he killed Carol, Julie, and Silvina.
sentences.zh: 另一个打击来自出租车司机珍妮·保罗，正是她在斯坦纳杀害卡罗尔、朱莉和西尔维娜的那晚载了他。

sentences.en: Jenny came forward only after learning of Stainer's arreSt.
sentences.zh: 珍妮是在得知斯坦纳被捕后才站出来的。

sentences.en: The FBI had never made inquiries with local cab companies during their investigation, even though it was standard practice for them to do so following a major crime.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局在调查期间从未向当地出租车公司进行过询问，尽管这在重大犯罪后是标准做法。

sentences.en: Special Agent James Maddock, who fronted the Yosemite sightseer murders investigation, was placed on administrative leave over his handling of the case.
sentences.zh: 负责优胜美地观光客谋杀案调查的特别探员詹姆斯·马多克，因处理此案不当而被行政停职。

sentences.en: Even though FBI officials supported his conduct, morale at the Sacramento field office was low due to the negative press coverage.
sentences.zh: 尽管联邦调查局官员支持他的行为，但由于负面新闻报道，萨克拉门托外勤办公室的士气低落。

sentences.en: Maddock was devastated to think that Joey Armstrong could still be alive had he not incorrectly assured the public that the Yosemite murderer was in jail.
sentences.zh: 马多克感到非常痛苦，因为如果他没有错误地向公众保证优胜美地杀手已被关进监狱，乔伊·阿姆斯特朗可能还活着。

sentences.en: In a highly divisive move, prosecutors sought the death penalty against Stainer in relation to Joey Armstrong's murder, describing his crimes as
sentences.zh: 在一项极具争议的举措中，检察官针对乔伊·阿姆斯特朗的谋杀案对斯坦纳寻求死刑，并将他的罪行描述为

sentences.en: As he didn't want to die, Stainer's survival instinct kicked in and he pleaded not guilty, despite having already confessed to the crime.
sentences.zh: 由于不想死，斯坦纳的求生本能被激发，他拒不认罪，尽管他之前已经供认了罪行。

sentences.en: In exchange for the prosecution dropping the death penalty, in September 2000, Stainer changed his plea to guilty.
sentences.zh: 为了换取检方放弃死刑，2000年9月，斯坦纳改口认罪。

sentences.en: Joey's mother, Leslie, agreed to the deal, saying that watching Stainer die wouldn't bring her daughter back.
sentences.zh: 乔伊的母亲莱斯利同意了这项协议，称看着斯坦纳死去也无法让她的女儿复活。

sentences.en: The plea stipulated that Stainer would be sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole, pardon, or any other kind of release for the length of his natural life.
sentences.zh: 认罪协议规定，斯坦纳将被判处终身监禁，不得假释、赦免或以任何其他方式获得释放，直至其自然死亡。

sentences.en: Stainer maintained his not guilty plea for the Yosemite sightseer murders.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳对优胜美地观光客谋杀案仍坚持不认罪。

sentences.en: During a preliminary hearing in June 2001, an employee of the Cedar Lodge revealed that Stainer had disappeared for a brief period on the day Carol, Julie,
sentences.zh: 在2001年6月的预审听证会上，雪松旅馆的一名员工透露，在卡罗尔、朱莉和西尔维娜失踪的那天，斯坦纳曾短暂消失，

sentences.en: and Sylvina vanished and couldn't be tracked down by staff.
sentences.zh: 且员工无法找到他。

sentences.en: On day three of the hearing, Stainer's six-hour-long murder confession was played to the court.
sentences.zh: 听证会第三天，法庭播放了斯坦纳长达六小时的谋杀供词录音。

sentences.en: At one point, a smile crept over Stainer's face.
sentences.zh: 在某一时刻，斯坦纳脸上浮现出一丝微笑。

sentences.en: Sylvina Peloso's father noticed and flew into a rage.
sentences.zh: 西尔维娜·佩洛索的父亲注意到了这一点，顿时怒不可遏。

sentences.en: He called Stainer a son of a bitch before storming out of the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 他骂斯坦纳是狗娘养的，随后冲出了法庭。

sentences.en: For the remainder of the audio presentation, Stainer kept his head bowed and his fingers plugged into his ears.
sentences.zh: 在剩余的音频播放过程中，斯坦纳一直低着头，用手指塞住耳朵。

sentences.en: It was ruled that there was enough evidence for Stainer to stand trial for the crimes.
sentences.zh: 法庭裁定有足够的证据让斯坦纳就这些罪行接受审判。

sentences.en: In May the following year, Stainer changed his plea from not guilty to innocent by reasons of insanity.
sentences.zh: 次年5月，斯坦纳将抗辩理由从“不认罪”改为“因精神错乱而无罪”。

sentences.en: His defence team were now claiming that he suffered from obsessive-compulsive disorder, depression, and unspecified psychosis.
sentences.zh: 他的辩护团队现在声称他患有强迫症、抑郁症和未指明的精神病。

sentences.en: If found guilty but insane, Stainer would face the possibility of life in a mental health facility.
sentences.zh: 如果被判有罪但精神错乱，斯坦纳将面临在精神卫生机构度过余生的可能。

sentences.en: If found guilty but sane, there was still a chance he would be executed.
sentences.zh: 如果被判有罪且精神正常，他仍有可能被处决。

sentences.en: During his trial in July, the defence claimed that their client's problems predated his birth.
sentences.zh: 在7月的审判中，辩方声称他们当事人的问题早在出生前就存在了。

sentences.en: Mental illness ran in the Stainer family.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳家族有精神疾病史。

sentences.en: Furthermore, Carey's mother fell over whilst pregnant with him, which might have damaged his brain.
sentences.zh: 此外，卡里的母亲在怀他时曾摔倒，这可能损伤了他的大脑。

sentences.en: From the age of two onwards, Stainer exhibited obsessive-compulsive behaviours, beginning with the chronic habit of pulling out hair.
sentences.zh: 从两岁起，斯坦纳就表现出强迫性行为，最初是拔头发的慢性习惯。

sentences.en: This evolved into full-blown psychosis.
sentences.zh: 这后来演变成了全面的精神病。

sentences.en: Stainer spoke of having visions of floating heads and hearing voices coming from the TV telling him to kill and that the world was coming to an end.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳谈到自己会出现漂浮头颅的幻觉，并听到电视里传出声音告诉他去杀人，还说世界末日即将来临。

sentences.en: A court-appointed forensic psychiatrist spent more than 21 hours interviewing Stainer and reviewed over 400 reports.
sentences.zh: 一名法院指定的法医精神病学家花了超过21小时采访斯坦纳，并查阅了400多份报告。

sentences.en: He testified that Stainer showed signs of depression, narcissism, and schizophrenia, and was socially dysfunctional.
sentences.zh: 他作证说，斯坦纳表现出抑郁、自恋和精神分裂症的迹象，且存在社交功能障碍。

sentences.en: He diagnosed Stainer with several sexual disorders, including pedophilia, sexual sadism, and erectile dysfunction.
sentences.zh: 他诊断斯坦纳患有多种性障碍，包括恋童癖、性施虐癖和勃起功能障碍。

sentences.en: A neuropsychologist appearing on behalf of the defence said a scan of Stainer's brain showed abnormalities in the parts that controlled emotional impulses.
sentences.zh: 一名代表辩方出庭的神经心理学家表示，斯坦纳的大脑扫描显示控制情绪冲动的部位存在异常。

sentences.en: However, a medical expert for the prosecution disagreed.
sentences.zh: 然而，检方的一名医学专家对此表示异议。

sentences.en: He believed the scans looked normal.
sentences.zh: 他认为扫描结果看起来很正常。

sentences.en: After two days' deliberation, Carey Stainer was found guilty on all charges.
sentences.zh: 经过两天的审议，卡里·斯坦纳被判所有指控成立。

sentences.en: He was also found to be of sound mind, with the jury citing the methodical and elaborate efforts he went to to cover up his crimes.
sentences.zh: 他还被认定精神正常，陪审团提到了他为掩盖罪行所采取的缜密而复杂的手段。

sentences.en: They said this showed a consciousness of guilt that indicated Stainer knew what he was doing was wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们表示这显示出一种罪恶意识，表明斯坦纳知道自己在做错事。

sentences.en: Their recommendation was unanimous.
sentences.zh: 他们的建议是一致的。

sentences.en: Carey Stainer should receive capital punishment.
sentences.zh: 卡里·斯坦纳应被判处死刑。

sentences.en: On December 12, 2002, Stainer was formally sentenced to death by lethal injection.
sentences.zh: 2002年12月12日，斯坦纳被正式判处注射死刑。

sentences.en: Stainer was sent to San Quentin State Prison, the only facility in California that still performed executions.
sentences.zh: 斯坦纳被送往圣昆廷州立监狱，这是加州唯一仍在执行死刑的设施。

sentences.en: Since the death penalty was reinstated in California in 1978, only 13 inmates have been executed.
sentences.zh: 自1978年加州恢复死刑以来，只有13名囚犯被处决。

sentences.en: The last execution took place in 2006.
sentences.zh: 最后一次处决发生在2006年。

sentences.en: The backlog is due to the lengthy appeals process, which can take many years before death row inmates have exhausted all their options.
sentences.zh: 积压的原因是漫长的上诉程序，死囚在耗尽所有选项前可能需要多年时间。

sentences.en: Holding inmates on death row costs $150 million more annually than if they were serving life without the possibility of parole.
sentences.zh: 关押死囚每年的成本比判处终身监禁不得假释要多出1.5亿美元。

sentences.en: In March 2019, the death penalty was suspended in California by Governor Gavin Newsom,
sentences.zh: 2019年3月，加州州长加文·纽森暂停了死刑，

sentences.en: who labelled it a costly failure unfairly applied to people of colour and the mentally disabled.
sentences.zh: 他称死刑是一项代价高昂的失败，且对有色人种和残障人士存在不公平的适用。

sentences.en: However, the moratorium is only in place during Governor Newsom's tenure, and the next Governor of California may seek to have the death penalty reinstated.
sentences.zh: 然而，这项暂停令仅在纽森州长任期内有效，下一任加州州长可能会寻求恢复死刑。

sentences.en: Carey Stainer remains on death row in San Quentin.
sentences.zh: 卡里·斯坦纳目前仍被关在圣昆廷监狱的死囚牢房里。

sentences.en: He is still fighting appeals.
sentences.zh: 他仍在进行上诉。

sentences.en: Room 509 at the Cedar Lodge is no longer available to the public and is now being used as a storage space.
sentences.zh: 雪松旅馆的509号房已不再对公众开放，现在被用作储藏室。

sentences.en: The Carroll Sund Carrington Memorial Reward Foundation is no longer in operation, having closed in 2009.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尔·桑德·卡林顿纪念奖励基金会已于2009年关闭，不再运作。

sentences.en: Over the decade it was running, the foundation paid 47 rewards, totalling $250,000.
sentences.zh: 在运营的十年间，该基金会共发放了47笔奖励，总额达25万美元。

sentences.en: In the wake of her murder, friends and family established the Joey Armstrong Memorial Fund, which offered trips to national parks for underprivileged children.
sentences.zh: 在她遇害后，朋友和家人成立了乔伊·阿姆斯特朗纪念基金，为贫困儿童提供前往国家公园旅行的机会。

sentences.en: The fund received so many donations that the Yosemite National Institute was able to establish the Armstrong Scholars Program.
sentences.zh: 该基金收到的捐款非常多，以至于优胜美地国家研究所得以设立了“阿姆斯特朗学者计划”。

sentences.en: It gave teenage girls the opportunity to spend 10 days in the Yosemite Wilderness, where they would be taught to hike, cook, climb and sleep outdoors.
sentences.zh: 它让十几岁的女孩有机会在优胜美地荒野度过10天，学习徒步、烹饪、攀岩和露营。

sentences.en: One of Joey's former students applied for the scholarship, writing on her application.
sentences.zh: 乔伊的一名学生申请了该奖学金，并在申请书上写道：

sentences.en: Joey became the red-headed free spirit in my life that kept encouraging me to ignore my fears, experience everything, and live life to the fulleSt.
sentences.zh: “乔伊成了我生命中那个红头发的自由灵魂，她不断鼓励我无视恐惧，体验一切，充实地生活。”

sentences.en: No one person has affected me more.
sentences.zh: 没有谁比她对我的影响更大。

sentences.en: Carey Stainer worked to sell the rights to his story for an autobiographical film adaptation of his crimes.
sentences.zh: 卡里·斯坦纳曾试图出售其故事版权，用于拍摄关于他罪行的自传电影。

sentences.en: When a reporter sought an exclusive interview with the killer, Stainer demanded in return,
sentences.zh: 当一名记者寻求对这名杀手的独家采访时，斯坦纳要求：

sentences.en: Get hold of producers in LA.
sentences.zh: “去联系洛杉矶的制片人。”

sentences.en: I want a bidding war.
sentences.zh: “我要一场竞价战。”

sentences.en: Criminologist Michael Rustigan stated Stainer was driven by the desire for fame, possibly the same that his brother received after surviving his ordeal.
sentences.zh: 犯罪学家迈克尔·拉斯蒂根指出，斯坦纳是被名利欲所驱使，这可能和他哥哥在经历磨难后获得的名声一样。

sentences.en: To guarantee he wouldn't profit from his story,
sentences.zh: 为了确保他不会从自己的故事中获利，

sentences.en: Carey Stainer was required to sign a $10 million restitution order to go to the Joey Armstrong Memorial Fund.
sentences.zh: 卡里·斯坦纳被要求签署一份1000万美元的赔偿令，款项将归入乔伊·阿姆斯特朗纪念基金。

sentences.en: To spare her family any further distress, he was forbidden from ever speaking, writing, or communicating with anyone about her death.
sentences.zh: 为了避免给她的家人带来进一步的痛苦，他被禁止与任何人谈论、书写或交流关于她死亡的事情。

sentences.en: The Sund and Peloso families both filed wrongful death suits against the Cedar Lodge and Carey Stainer.
sentences.zh: 桑德和佩洛索家族都对雪松旅馆和卡里·斯坦纳提起了非正常死亡诉讼。

sentences.en: It questioned why Carol, Julie, and Sylvina were put in a remote room with few other guests nearby.
sentences.zh: 诉讼质疑为什么卡罗尔、朱莉和西尔维娜被安排在一个偏僻的房间，附近几乎没有其他客人。

sentences.en: Why Stainer was allowed to wander the grounds unsupervised with a master key, And whether there was an adequate lock system on the hotel room door.
sentences.zh: 为什么斯坦纳被允许拿着万能钥匙在无人监督的情况下在场地内游荡，以及酒店房门是否有足够的锁闭系统。

sentences.en: It also argued that the Cedar Lodge conducted inadequate background checks on its employees.
sentences.zh: 诉讼还指出，雪松旅馆对其员工的背景调查不足。

sentences.en: If they had, they would have learnt that Stainer had made threats to kill a previous employer and torch their workplace.
sentences.zh: 如果他们做了调查，就会发现斯坦纳曾威胁要杀害前雇主并烧毁他们的工作场所。

sentences.en: The families were clear that the suit was more about accountability than money.
sentences.zh: 各家庭明确表示，诉讼更多是为了追究责任，而非为了钱。

sentences.en: They wanted to send a message to the community that accommodation providers needed to be held to the highest standards of care in order to protect their guests.
sentences.zh: 他们想向社区传达一个信息：住宿提供者必须保持最高标准的护理，以保护他们的客人。

sentences.en: Yen's sons settled for $1 million.
sentences.zh: 延的儿子们达成了100万美元的和解协议。

sentences.en: The Peloso family rejected their settlement offer, as it didn't even cover their legal fees.
sentences.zh: 佩洛索家族拒绝了他们的和解提议，因为它甚至不够支付他们的律师费。

sentences.en: In May the following year, a judge threw out the Peloso's case, saying the Cedar Lodge managers couldn't have foreseen Carey Stainer's actions.
sentences.zh: 次年5月，一名法官驳回了佩洛索家族的案件，称雪松旅馆的经理们无法预见卡里·斯坦纳的行为。

sentences.en: Shortly after confessing to his crimes, Carey Stainer took the advice of detectives and penned letters to his victiMs.
sentences.zh: 在供认罪行后不久，卡里·斯坦纳听从了侦探的建议，给他的受害者写了信。

sentences.en: Although they weren't around to read them, the letters would provide Stainer the opportunity to speak candidly and personally about what he had done,
sentences.zh: 虽然她们已不在人世无法阅读，但这些信件让斯坦纳有机会坦诚且私下地谈论他所做的一切，

sentences.en: offering further insight into his mind.
sentences.zh: 从而进一步洞察他的内心。

sentences.en: In a letter to Julie Sund, he wrote,
sentences.zh: 在给朱莉·桑德的一封信中，他写道：

sentences.en: You, on one hand, have crossed over to a place of which now I can only dream of going.
sentences.zh: “你，一方面，已经去了一个我只能梦想去的地方。”

sentences.en: And I am going someplace far worse.
sentences.zh: “而我，正要去一个远为糟糕的地方。”
